description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the application's Oracle database integration to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including photo binary data storage and managed identity authentication.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC configuration and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service, and managed identity replaces plaintext database credentials.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL JDBC driver and update Spring datasource configuration and Hibernate dialect for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Convert Oracle-specific SQL and schema definitions to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents, including Oracle BLOB photo data to PostgreSQL bytea. Configure database authentication with managed identity and remove plaintext database credentials. Update application.properties and application-docker.properties to use the Azure Database for PostgreSQL endpoint and managed identity authentication.
